description: This file defines a UI component named 'Spinner' using the LightningJS framework. The component displays a spinning element with a label, simulating a loading indicator.

methods.name: labelText
methods.description: Computed property that returns the label text or a default 'Loading...'

methods.name: onMounted
methods.description: Initializes a timer to update the spinner's rotation angle periodically.

methods.name: onDestroyed
methods.description: Clears the timer when the component is destroyed to prevent memory leaks.
